_doc: An example of the journey apps file. Your own copy goes to ~/.config/claude-annotate/journey/apps.json (JOURNEY_APPS names another file); when that exists it replaces this one.

A journey belongs to a sandbox: each sandbox (on a machine with no sandboxes, each checkout) has its own canvas, registered by `journey.py register` with key <app>-<name>. This file says only how each app's journeys are read and re-run.
name: what the canvas calls the app.
features: where the feature ids come from. gherkin: a journey.feature's Scenarios as slugs (@skip kept), relative to the canvas's sandbox, else the session home.

run: argv that re-runs features in the canvas's sandbox and publishes them; {features} is the chosen ids, nothing for every feature; {--name} is `--name <the canvas's sandbox>`; {cli} is the app CLI (config `cli`, under config `home`); {home} is the session home; {checkout} is the canvas's own checkout. A relative first word is a file of that checkout, run from there (a machine with no sandboxes).
after: argv run once the run ends, whatever its result (null for none). env: added to the run's environment.
results: the folder, relative to the sandbox, whose <feature>/manifest.json the run writes (status, finishedAt, boards, error).
